scope: Selected Steam FPS releases from 1 January 2025 through 28 September 2026, plus a separate watchlist of older Early Access games and upcoming titles. Full releases and Early Access entries use different date labels. This is a checked snapshot, not an exhaustive catalog or a live release feed. Released games with fewer than 30 observed total Steam reviews are omitted; unreleased watchlist entries remain separately labeled.
indieDefinition: Independent and creator-led development is the editorial focus. External publishers are allowed and named. Studio statements or individual credits support each inclusion; the Steam Indie tag alone is not proof. We have not audited ownership, funding, budgets or total team sizes.
